params.body:
Step 2b of removing the demo flag. Step 1 (#892) retired the demo garages, step 2a (#901) removed every read of `dealers.is_demo_user`, and #904 and #905 took the pair `'is_demo_user' => 0` out of 142 fixtures so the column can go. This pull request removes what was left of the flag and the separate demo environment from the code. Demonstrations run on real accounts since 1 October 2026, so there is no second environment to recognise, rebuild or keep shut.

Three different things carried the word "demo". Two go, one stays.

## Map

### 1. The demo flag (goes)

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Columns dropped | migration `2026_10_01_150100_drop_the_demo_flag_columns`: `dealers.is_demo_user`, `users.is_demo_user` (the twin on the user row, never set by the application), `users.can_rebase` (who could rebuild the demo database). Each column is checked first, so it can run twice. |
| `@property` / `@method` lines | `app/Models/Settings/Dealer.php`, `app/Models/Settings/User.php` |
| Fixtures still setting it | none left: swept in #904 and #905 (140 test files, `tests/PageSeed.php`, `DemoScreensSeeder`), split off because one snapshot of every file was too large to propose |
| Schema dump | `database/schema/mysql-schema.sql` loses the three columns, so a fresh database never has them and the drop migration finds nothing to do there. Migration `2026_09_15_180000` placed its column `after('is_demo_user')` and runs after the dump on a fresh database; that positional hint is removed (where the migration already ran, nothing changes). |

### 2. The demo environment (goes)

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| The database check | `app/Support/Demo.php` (`Demo::active()`), deleted, and every branch on it in `app/Support/Outbound.php` (`allowed`, `allows`, `impact`, `mailReason`, `explanation`, `sealRefusal`, `seal`, `reason`) |
| The reset screen | `app/Http/Controllers/StocklistRebaseController.php`, the route `stocklistrebase.index.reset` in `routes/web.php`, the button in `resources/views/layouts/omgevingsbalk.blade.php`, `custom.resetDatabase` in `resources/js/custom.js`, the lang keys `menu.stocklistrebase` and `vehicle.resetall` (nl, en, fr, de) |
| Menu row and rights | migration `2026_10_01_150000_remove_the_demo_reset_menu_rows`: deletes the `menus` rows with security `stocklistrebase` and their `role_access` rows. Idempotent, no transaction (both tables are MyISAM). |
| Commands | `stocklist:rebasedemo` (`RebaseDemo`), `notifications:demo-seed` (`DemoSeedNotifications`), `bidding:demo-refresh` (`DemoRefreshBiddings`) |
| Configuration | the `demo_mysql` connection in `config/database.php`; `DB_DEMO_DATABASE` in `.env.example` and `README.md` |
| The environment bar | no `DEMO-OMGEVING` label and no `data-environment="demo"`: the bar says `TESTOMGEVING` or the preview label |
| PHPStan baseline | five entries of the removed files |
| Quality ratchet | `blade_onclick` 242 to 241 (the reset button) |

Rules (codes frozen, nothing renumbered):

| Rule | Change |
|---|---|
| R P1-7.1 | `stocklist:daily` runs on production only; the "no active demo" half is described as history |
| R P3-4.1 | webhooks leave on production only; the demo half is history |
| R S3-1.6 | outside production means staging and preview; the demo database is history |
| P3-7 intro, R P3-7.5, R P3-7.10 | no demo environment, no rebuild button |
| R P3-7.11 (new) | there is no separate demo environment; the seal has one condition; what was removed and what stays. Pinned by `TheDemoEnvironmentIsGoneTest` (`@rule P3-7.11`). |
| R B1-2.15 | "(preview, demo)" becomes "(preview, staging)" |
| R P2-1.12 (already `vervallen`) | its last sentences said the column still existed and the environment stayed; both are now corrected |

Also updated: `CLAUDE.md` (the seal paragraph under Gotchas), `docs/preview.md`, `CUTOVER.md` (two lines).

### 3. What stays, unchanged

- **The seal of every non-production environment** (`Outbound::seal()`, `OUTBOUND_ALLOW`, `OUTBOUND_IMPACT`, the mail lock). Staging, preview and a laptop behave exactly as before. The existing staging assertions in `OutboundTest`, `MailRedirectTest` and `PreviewEnvironmentTest` are untouched; only the cases that set up a demo database were removed, and two tests that ran "as production on the demo database" now run in the plain non-production environment and assert the same thing (nothing is sent, the VIN lookup answers 422).
- `stocklist:demo-screens` with `DemoScreensSeeder`, and `stocklist:mail-preview`: local tooling, independent of the demo environment. The test asserts both are still registered.
- `InsightsRepository::DEMO`: the cleaning of demo activity on real garages (relation 135, staff users, the Ilse sheets).

## Ambiguous, and what was decided

1. **`DemoMediaDisk` is not demo-only.** `Outbound::seal()` installs it on every non-production environment: it is what keeps an upload on staging or the preview from overwriting a real photo in the shared bucket. Deleting it would have changed staging and preview. It is renamed to `App\Support\SealedMediaDisk` (and `DemoMediaTest` to `SealedMediaDiskTest`), with identical behaviour and identical tests; no reference to the old name remains in the code.
2. **The bucket prefix `demo/` stays.** Staging and the preview have their uploads and derived sizes there, and `resolve()` assumes derived sizes live under it. Renaming the prefix would orphan those files and show empty tiles. The docblock and R P3-7.11 say that the folder keeps its old name and belongs to every sealed environment. Consequence for the checklist below: the prefix cannot be purged as "the demo's".
3. **`must_use_in_rebase`** (six vehicle tables: photos, damages, options) is also a leftover of the old rebase and is read nowhere. It is **not** dropped here: those are the largest tables of the schema and a column drop rebuilds them during a deploy. Left for a separate, planned migration; the `@property` lines stay as long as the columns exist.
4. **`bidding:demo-refresh`** did not call `Demo::active()`, but it existed to revive expired auctions in the demo dump. The preview gets live auctions every night, so nothing needs it. Removed.
5. **`$warrantyDemo`** in `StocklistBrowser` and `Vehicle::showsWarrantyBadge()` is seal behaviour (`! Outbound::allowed()`), not the demo environment, despite its name. Untouched.
6. **Comments that mention "demo" as an example of a non-production environment** (in `Daily`, `MollieService`, `OwnStockService` and others) are left where the code around them is not touched; they are wording, not behaviour. Historical documents (`docs/refactor-logboek.md`, the findings) are left as history.
7. **A leftover `DB_DEMO_DATABASE` on production** does nothing any more: the connection is gone from the configuration, and a test pins that production is recognised by `APP_ENV` alone even when such a value is present.

## For the owner: infrastructure that code cannot remove

- [ ] Forge: delete the demo site (`demo-stocklistdealer.on-forge.com`) and its release folders on the production server
- [ ] Forge: remove that site's scheduler entry (`schedule:run`), any daemon or queue worker, and its deploy webhook, if they exist
- [ ] MySQL: drop the demo database (`demo_stocklistdealer_db`, or whatever `DB_DEMO_DATABASE` names on the server) and any MySQL user that only served it
- [ ] DNS: remove the record of the demo hostname, and its certificate in Forge
- [ ] `.env` of production, staging and preview (Forge, Environment): delete `DB_DEMO_DATABASE`. It is the only key that became unused.
- [ ] Any cron line outside Laravel that still calls `stocklist:rebasedemo`, `notifications:demo-seed` or `bidding:demo-refresh`: the commands no longer exist and such a line would fail every run
- [ ] Bucket prefix `demo/`: do **not** purge it wholesale. Staging and the preview write there. Only what the old demo site itself uploaded is orphaned, and it cannot be told apart from staging's files by path; leave it, or clear it together with a refresh of staging.
- [ ] Monitoring: remove the demo address from uptime checks, if it is listed anywhere

## After the deploy

Both migrations run with the deploy (`migrate --force`). The column drops touch `dealers` and `users` only, both small, and each column is checked before it is dropped. `down()` puts the three columns back as nullable booleans with default 0, which is what they were; the menu migration has no way back because the screen it pointed at no longer exists.

## Tests

- `TheDemoEnvironmentIsGoneTest` (new): the reset route answers 404 for an administrator who holds the old right; the three commands are not registered while `stocklist:demo-screens` and `stocklist:mail-preview` are; production is recognised by its environment alone; the three columns are gone; the menu migration removes the row and its rights, leaves other rows alone and can run twice; and a search over `app`, `config`, `routes`, `resources`, `tests`, the seeders, `.env.example`, `README.md` and the PHPStan baseline finds no `is_demo_user`, `Demo::active`, `DemoMediaDisk`, `demo_mysql`, `DB_DEMO_DATABASE` or `stocklistrebase`.
- Full suite locally on a private database built from the edited dump: 2655 tests, green.
- PHPStan: no errors. Pint: clean on the three new files. Vitest: green.
params.title: The demo environment is gone: no second lock on the seal, no reset screen, no flag columns
